name: nextbrowser
description: NextBrowser desktop agent console for macOS and Windows
author: NextBrowser

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
